# Grok Bot Skills

> Community-maintained, MIT-licensed Agent Skills for Grok bot workflows and skill-compatible AI assistants. Plain Markdown instructions, not an official xAI product or a hosted runtime.

## Overview
- Repository: https://github.com/ofershap/grok-bot-skills
- README: README.md
- Contribution guide: CONTRIBUTING.md
- Format: https://agentskills.io/specification

## Skill catalog
- Short answers: skills/short-answers/SKILL.md - concise, answer-first replies.
- Slack voice: skills/slack-voice/SKILL.md - draft messages using supplied voice examples; approval before sending.
- Distill need: skills/distill-need/SKILL.md - find the real need before building a proposed solution.
- Make it click: skills/make-it-click/SKILL.md - concrete explanations when a previous explanation failed.
- Monthly checkpoint: skills/monthly-checkpoint/SKILL.md - evidence-based keep/change/stop review of a habit or tool.

## Installation and limits
- Install through a compatible Agent Skills loader, or use selected instructions manually as context.
- CLI: npx skills add ofershap/grok-bot-skills
- Grok-specific loaders have not been tested here; do not claim universal compatibility.
- Skills do not grant private account access, permission to send messages, or a scheduler.
- Contributions need review, synthetic examples, attribution, and privacy checks.
